name: preranker-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Alibaba-NLP/gte-reranker-modernbert-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: cross-encoder (ModernBERT), full bidirectional attention over query+passage with local+global attention pattern
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of Alibaba-NLP/gte-reranker-modernbert-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.15 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-04-07. CAVEAT: one epoch of ListNetLoss on the authors' own BEIR conversion of ToolRet; the eval set is the task family the model was trained for (tool retrieval), so the margins are small (+0.016 Recall@10, +0.006 NDCG@10) and no CI is printed.
